description: Railroad, Company and Organization List is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Railroads", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation. This a list of active and inactive railroads, companies, and other organizations related to railroad operations. Organization Type ID = 1 designates a railroad; 4 designates a non-railroad organization (e.g. company, shipper, public entity, etc.). Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Railroads". It has 6 columns, among them StartDate, OrganizationCode, OrganizationTypeID, EndDate, ID, Name. The portal shows 2024-08-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
